text: Applied economics is a branch of economics that focuses on the analysis of actual economic issues, policy formulation and practical application. It is based on basic economic theories and uses quantitative analysis and empirical research to solve specific problems in reality, such as resource allocation, market operation, and public policies. From government fiscal subsidy policies to enterprises' market pricing strategies, from regional economic development planning to responses to international trade frictions, all fall within the scope of research in applied economics.
